== Summary ==
Helge Blohmer and a young friend face off in Young Jedi World Championships on Saturday. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Young Jedi World Championship|Young Jedi at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
